entities.name: PMID:25097278
observations: 2014 Indian Journal of Pharmacology study titled “Sildenafil enhances the peripheral antinociceptive effect of ellagic acid in the rat formalin test.”
Subeffective sildenafil doses of 25 or 50 μg/paw enhanced subeffective ellagic acid at 60 μg/paw versus ellagic acid alone in rats.
Enhancement was reported in both the early neurogenic and late inflammatory formalin-test phases.

entities.name: Sildenafil
observations: At 25 or 50 μg/paw, sildenafil potentiated the peripheral antinociceptive effect of 60 μg/paw ellagic acid in the rat formalin test.

entities.name: Ellagic acid
observations: A 60 μg/paw subeffective dose showed enhanced antinociception when combined with sildenafil in the rat formalin test.
